title.narrative: Operation and equipping project for the Sheikh Saleh Al-Rajhi Cultural Center in Mentawai

description.narrative: The project supports the Sheikh Saleh Al-Rajhi Cultural Center in Mentawai by covering operational expenses, thereby contributing to improved quality of education and human resources, and achieving economic empowerment for the center through the establishment of a goat farm and a grocery store.
To enhance the independence of the Sheikh Saleh Al-Rajhi Cultural Center in Mentawai, contribute to improving the quality of education, and ensure the center's continued operation.
To ensure that 141 beneficiaries, including 31 teachers and administrators, and 110 students, receive services from the cultural center.
